title: VaaniShield Dataset Scale & Generalization Power Analysis
technical_debt_acknowledgement: The current 400-recording / 8-speaker corpus constitutes a rigorous academic pilot and proof-of-concept demonstrating the efficacy of SNAP speaker-nulling and code-switch boundary discontinuity detection. However, 50 held-out clips from a single speaker yield wide 95% confidence intervals (±13.2%). Commercial banking deployment demands a multi-center corpus of >= 2,000 speakers and >= 50,000 utterances to achieve tight statistical confidence bounds (±0.9%) and cover dialectal prosody across all 28 Indian states.
